mapper.sql: sku.id as sku_id, p.name as product_name, sku.sku_name, sku.thumb_img, sku.sale_price, sku.market_price, sku.sku_spec, p.unit_name, case when sku.stock_num > 0 then 1 else 0 end as in_stock
mapper.select: select from product_sku sku inner join product p on p.id = sku.product_id where sku.id = #{skuId} and sku.status = 1 and sku.is_deleted = 0 and p.status = 1 and p.audit_status = 1 and p.is_deleted = 0

select sku.id as sku_id, p.id as product_id, p.category3_id as category_id, p.brand_id, p.name as product_name, sku.sku_name, b.name as brand_name, concat_ws(' > ', c1.name, c2.name, c3.name) as category_path, p.spec_value as product_spec, sku.sku_spec, p.unit_name, greatest(p.update_time, sku.update_time) as knowledge_updated_at from product_sku sku inner join product p on p.id = sku.product_id left join brand b on b.id = p.brand_id and b.is_deleted = 0 left join category c1 on c1.id = p.category1_id and c1.is_deleted = 0 left join category c2 on c2.id = p.category2_id and c2.is_deleted = 0 left join category c3 on c3.id = p.category3_id and c3.is_deleted = 0 where sku.id > #{afterSkuId} and sku.status = 1 and sku.is_deleted = 0 and p.status = 1 and p.audit_status = 1 and p.is_deleted = 0 order by sku.id asc limit #{limit}

select sku.id as sku_id, p.id as product_id, p.category3_id as category_id, p.brand_id, p.name as product_name, sku.sku_name, b.name as brand_name, concat_ws(' > ', c1.name, c2.name, c3.name) as category_path, p.spec_value as product_spec, sku.sku_spec, p.unit_name, greatest(p.update_time, sku.update_time) as knowledge_updated_at from product_sku sku inner join product p on p.id = sku.product_id left join brand b on b.id = p.brand_id and b.is_deleted = 0 left join category c1 on c1.id = p.category1_id and c1.is_deleted = 0 left join category c2 on c2.id = p.category2_id and c2.is_deleted = 0 left join category c3 on c3.id = p.category3_id and c3.is_deleted = 0 where p.id = #{productId} and sku.status = 1 and sku.is_deleted = 0 and p.status = 1 and p.audit_status = 1 and p.is_deleted = 0 order by sku.id asc
